description: This file implements the SetCaps class for configuring audio stream capabilities in a WebAudio context, including building GStreamer caps based on audio configuration and mime type, and updating the GStreamer pipeline accordingly.

classes.name: WebAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Abstract base class for building GStreamer caps for WebAudio streams.

classes.name: WebAudioPcmCapsBuilder
classes.description: Concrete implementation of WebAudioCapsBuilder for PCM audio configuration.

classes.name: SetCaps
classes.description: Main class responsible for setting GStreamer caps based on WebAudio configuration and mime type.

methods.name: SetCaps
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SetCaps object with context, wrappers, mime type, and config.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the process of creating and setting GStreamer caps based on mime type.

methods.name: createCapsFromMimeType
methods.description: Creates GstCaps object based on the mime type and configuration.

methods.name: setBytesPerSample
methods.description: Calculates and sets the bytes per sample in the context based on the configuration.
